Executable code plus output and table accompany the proof.

value.rationale: Natural question for the canonical 4×4 strongly regular rook graph: a nontrivial 105-dimensional homology module decomposes into 11 rational irreducibles and shows distinct invariants under five natural groups, including full-quotient rational acyclicity versus a five-class diagonal quotient. It is not implied by the known sphere count.
